entries.name: sim_print_int
entries.summary: Print integer. value: integer to print.

entries.name: sim_print_float
entries.summary: Print float. value: float to print.

entries.name: sim_print_double
entries.summary: Print double. value: double to print.

entries.name: sim_print_string
entries.summary: Print string. text: address of null-terminated string to print.

entries.name: sim_read_int
entries.summary: Read integer. Result: contains integer read.

entries.name: sim_read_float
entries.summary: Read float. Result: contains float read.

entries.name: sim_read_double
entries.summary: Read double. Result: contains double read.

entries.name: sim_read_string
entries.summary: Read string. buffer: address of input buffer. size: maximum number of characters to read.

entries.name: sim_sbrk
entries.summary: Sbrk (allocate heap memory). bytes: number of bytes to allocate. Result: contains address of allocated memory.

entries.name: sim_exit
entries.summary: Exit (terminate execution).

entries.name: sim_print_char
entries.summary: Print character. character: character to print.

entries.name: sim_read_char
entries.summary: Read character. Result: contains character read.

entries.name: sim_get_cwd
entries.summary: Get cwd. buffer: address of the buffer to write the path into. size: length of the buffer. Result: contains -1 if the path and its terminating null do not fit in the buffer, and is left unchanged otherwise.

entries.name: sim_time
entries.summary: Time (program time).

entries.name: sim_sleep
entries.summary: Sleep. milliseconds: the length of time to sleep in milliseconds.

entries.name: sim_print_hex
entries.summary: Print integer in hexadecimal. value: integer to print.

entries.name: sim_print_binary
entries.summary: Print integer in binary. value: integer to print.

entries.name: sim_print_unsigned
entries.summary: Print integer as unsigned. value: integer to print.

entries.name: sim_random_seed
entries.summary: Set seed. generator: i.d. of pseudorandom number generator (any int). seed: seed for corresponding pseudorandom number generator.

entries.name: sim_random_int
entries.summary: Random int. generator: i.d. of pseudorandom number generator (any int). Result: contains the next pseudorandom, uniformly distributed int value from this random number generator's sequence.

entries.name: sim_random_int_range
entries.summary: Random int range. generator: i.d. of pseudorandom number generator (any int). bound: upper bound of range of returned values. Result: contains pseudorandom, uniformly distributed int value in the range 0 <= [int] < [upper bound], drawn from this random number generator's sequence.

entries.name: sim_random_float
entries.summary: Random float. generator: i.d. of pseudorandom number generator (any int). Result: contains the next pseudorandom, uniformly distributed float value in the range 0.0 <= f < 1.0 from this random number generator's sequence.

entries.name: sim_random_double
entries.summary: Random double. generator: i.d. of pseudorandom number generator (any int). Result: contains the next pseudorandom, uniformly distributed double value in the range 0.0 <= f < 1.0 from this random number generator's sequence.

entries.name: sim_confirm_dialog
entries.summary: ConfirmDialog. message: address of null-terminated string that is the message to user. Result: contains value of user-chosen option 0: Yes 1: No 2: Cancel.

entries.name: sim_input_dialog_int
entries.summary: InputDialogInt. message: address of null-terminated string that is the message to user. status: contains status value 0: OK status -1: input data cannot be correctly parsed -2: Cancel was chosen -3: OK was chosen but no data had been input into field. Result: contains int read.

entries.name: sim_input_dialog_float
entries.summary: InputDialogFloat. message: address of null-terminated string that is the message to user. status: contains status value 0: OK status -1: input data cannot be correctly parsed -2: Cancel was chosen -3: OK was chosen but no data had been input into field. Result: contains float read.

entries.name: sim_input_dialog_double
entries.summary: InputDialogDouble. message: address of null-terminated string that is the message to user. status: contains status value 0: OK status -1: input data cannot be correctly parsed -2: Cancel was chosen -3: OK was chosen but no data had been input into field. Result: contains double read.

entries.name: sim_input_dialog_string
entries.declaration: int sim_input_dialog_string(const char *message, char *buffer, int size)
entries.summary: InputDialogString. message: address of null-terminated string that is the message to user. buffer: address of input buffer. size: maximum number of characters to read. Result: contains status value 0: OK status. Buffer contains the input string. -2: Cancel was chosen. No change to buffer. -3: OK was chosen but no data had been input into field. No change to buffer. -4: length of the input string exceeded the specified maximum. Buffer contains the maximum allowable input string plus a terminating null..

entries.name: sim_message_dialog
entries.summary: MessageDialog. message: address of null-terminated string that is the message to user. type: the type of message to be displayed: 0: error message, indicated by Error icon 1: information message, indicated by Information icon 2: warning message, indicated by Warning icon 3: question message, indicated by Question icon other: plain message (no icon displayed).

entries.name: sim_message_dialog_int
entries.summary: MessageDialogInt. message: address of null-terminated string that is an information-type message to user. value: int value to display in string form after the first string.

entries.name: sim_close
entries.summary: Close file. fd: file descriptor.

entries.name: sim_message_dialog_double
entries.summary: MessageDialogDouble. message: address of null-terminated string that is an information-type message to user. value: double value to display in string form after the first string.

entries.name: sim_message_dialog_string
entries.summary: MessageDialogString. message: address of null-terminated string that is an information-type message to user. text: address of null-terminated string to display after the first string.

entries.name: sim_message_dialog_float
entries.summary: MessageDialogFloat. message: address of null-terminated string that is an information-type message to user. value: float value to display in string form after the first string.

entries.name: sim_lseek
entries.declaration: int sim_lseek(int fd, int offset, int whence)
entries.summary: Lseek (move file position). fd: file descriptor. offset: offset in bytes. whence: where the offset counts from: 0 the start of the file, 1 the current position, 2 the end of the file. Result: contains the new position, counted from the beginning of the file (-1 if error).

entries.name: sim_read
entries.declaration: int sim_read(int fd, void *buffer, int length)
entries.summary: Read from file. fd: file descriptor. buffer: address of input buffer. length: maximum number of characters to read. Result: contains number of characters read (0 if end-of-file, negative if error).

entries.name: sim_write
entries.declaration: int sim_write(int fd, const void *buffer, int length)
entries.summary: Write to file. fd: file descriptor. buffer: address of output buffer. length: number of characters to write. Result: contains number of characters written (negative if error).

entries.name: sim_exit2
entries.summary: Exit2 (terminate with value). code: termination result.

entries.name: sim_open
entries.declaration: int sim_open(const char *path, int flags, int mode)
entries.summary: Open file. path: address of null-terminated string containing filename. flags: flags. mode: mode. Result: contains file descriptor (negative if error).

entries.name: sim_keyboard_ready
entries.summary: Returns nonzero if a typed character is waiting.

entries.name: sim_keyboard_read
entries.summary: Reads and removes the waiting character. Check sim_keyboard_ready first.

entries.name: sim_display_ready
entries.summary: Returns nonzero if the Terminal can accept a character.

entries.name: sim_display_write
entries.summary: Prints a character in the Terminal. Character 12 clears the Terminal.

entries.name: sim_rgb
entries.declaration: unsigned sim_rgb(int red, int green, int blue)
entries.summary: Creates a Screen color from red, green and blue components, each from 0 to 255.

entries.name: SIM_SCREEN
entries.summary: Defines a global array of Screen cells and configures the Screen at Build. Use outside functions; each cell covers unit by unit pixels.
